items.text: Deploy AppJuice on Linux x64 or ARM64 with help from an Agent. The guided setup detects the machine, configures Cloudflare Access and Tunnel, and installs a verified server package. Initial supported systems are Ubuntu 24.04 x64 and Debian 12 ARM64, including compatible Raspberry Pi hardware. You complete required sign-in and authorization steps.
Installed Web apps have clearer icons and use the name AppJuice Web by default. Administrators can add an installation label while each App keeps its own name and icon.
Runtime Agent file attachments are accepted correctly when uploaded to a conversation.
Coding Agent commands work when a model leaves unused access fields empty. Automatic safety review retains your latest request across repeated tool attempts.
Accounts that can only use shared Apps now see a clear access explanation when opening a development page.
